name: Residence Permit for Family Purposes, Spouse of a Mongolian Citizen (F1)

requirements.blocker_text: Married to a Mongolian citizen, evidenced by a translated marriage certificate and a copy of the spouse's Mongolian ID.
Health clearance including an HIV test is a required document for this permit category.

outcome.duration_length: issued for up to 1 year at a time for the first two years

sources.title: Immigration Agency of Mongolia -- F1 family residence permit for spouses of Mongolian citizens: marriage certificate (translated), spouse's ID, police record, HIV/health clearance, proof of financial means, biometric registration; issued up to 1 year at a time for the first two years; 135,000 MNT standard processing, $7 residency card fee

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Mongolia). STATUS: PUBLISHED -- fully tier-1 sourced. This models F1 (spouse of a Mongolian citizen) specifically; the Immigration Agency also lists F2/F3 sub-categories and an H2 'private purpose' category tied to relationship with an H1 (talent/needed-profession) permit holder, neither of which was independently fetched in this pass -- disclosed as a scope limitation, since F1 (marriage to a citizen) is the clearest, most universally-applicable family route and matches this dataset's convention elsewhere. NOTABLE: this dataset's convention elsewhere flags gendered asymmetry where found; the F1 source language ('Mongolian spouse') is gender-neutral with no wife/husband distinction found in this pass. citizenship route: Mongolia's naturalisation law (Article 3.3, see mn_citizenship_naturalisation.json) explicitly states marriage does NOT itself change or accelerate citizenship acquisition -- unlike Romania's or Chad's marriage-linked reduced-residence provisions, Mongolia's Law on Citizenship contains no marriage-based fast track found in this pass, a genuine structural absence disclosed rather than invented. pr_after_months/citizenship_after_months here follow the same general residence-accumulation path as other temporary permits (no accelerated marriage track confirmed).
